Seer.directive_rationale: when Hoang began attacking you, you should have leaned harder on the 'Confirmed Core' logic to rally the village
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang (Seer) responded to Nhan's attacks by repeatedly stating that Nhan was targeting 'confirmed villagers' and asserting his own role as Seer to validate Nam and Jin.
Seer.verdict_notes: Hoang leaned on the logic of confirmed roles to defend himself and rally others against Nhan.

Guard.directive_rationale: The Seer is the village's only source of mechanical truth; they must be protected every single night regardless of other suspicions
Guard.actual_player_behavior: In Round 1 Night, Nhan (Guard) chose to protect Riley (Werewolf) instead of Hoang (Seer). In Round 2 Night, Nhan protected Hoang.
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard failed to protect the Seer in the first night but did so in the second.

Witch.directive_rationale: When you are accused, you must provide mechanical evidence or voting patterns to defend your role rather than simple counter-accusations
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong (Witch) was accused by Nam and Hoang; Cong responded by questioning Hoang's claim and demanding verification rather than providing evidence of their own role.
Witch.verdict_notes: Cong did not provide any mechanical evidence or voting patterns to defend themselves, focusing instead on challenging the Seer.

Witch.directive_rationale: your lack of presence in the Day 1 debate allowed the village to exile you
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong actively participated in the Day 1 debate, questioning the Seer's claim and voting for Nam.
Witch.verdict_notes: Cong was vocal and present in the debate, although the nature of the participation led to their exile.

Villager.directive_rationale: Any player attacking the Core (like Hoang did) should be the primary target
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam (Villager) targeted Nhan for exile after Nhan attacked Hoang (the Seer) and the confirmed core.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nam identified Nhan as the target for exile specifically because Nhan was attacking the Seer.

Villager.directive_rationale: you must ensure the Seer is not isolated
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin (Villager) stated, 'I will defend Hoang and Nhan until proven otherwise' after Hoang claimed to be Seer.
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin explicitly stated their intent to defend the Seer.

Villager.directive_rationale: you should have prioritized the silent players over the vocal Seer once the Seer's results remained consistent
Villager.verdict_notes: The villagers did not shift focus to silent players; they remained focused on the conflict between the claimed Seer and the accusers.

Villager.directive_rationale: the village failed to apply the 'Anti-Echo Protocol' to those who provided no new mechanical evidence
Villager.verdict_notes: There was no evidence of the village attempting or applying an anti-echo protocol.

Villager.directive_rationale: the village allowed a dispute between the Seer and a cleared Villager to distract from the silent Werewolves
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam and Jin were caught in a dispute with Nhan (who had been cleared by the Seer in Round 1). Nam and Jin focused entirely on exiling Nhan rather than looking at other players.
Villager.verdict_notes: The villagers focused on the dispute between the Seer's cleared member (Nhan) and the Seer himself, rather than ignoring it to find silent wolves.
